verified_positive: For all 4 legacy URLs, the superadmin NEVER transits through /admin/* (the un-renderable P0-guarded screen) any more. RedirectWithTracking correctly computes the differentiated superadminTo target from ba0a4759d2 (visible transiently in page.url()) and the domains fallback correctly produces /superadmin?from=%2Forganization%2Fdomains. No crash, no white screen, no console error (only a pre-existing informational warning).
residual_finding_NOT_part_of_TRI-MUST-04: SuperAdminView (src/views/superadmin/SuperAdminView.tsx:83-95) keys its rendered tab off the Zustand `currentView` app-state, not off the URL. `<Navigate to={superadminTo} replace>` only changes the browser location, it never calls setCurrentView(). Because currentView still holds a non-SUPERADMIN_* value from the settings/organization AppView mapping, SuperAdminView's own (pre-existing, unrelated to this fix) normalization effect fires a SECOND replace back to the generic /superadmin/customers within ~250-500ms, so the specific commercial-billing/organizations/users landing and the domains ?from= query never durably render — the user ends up on the generic Tenant Command Center for all 4 cases. This is a separate, narrower UX gap (loses the specific-tab intent) than the P0-guard bounce TRI-MUST-04 fixed, and does not reopen the P0/security defect.
